packageRules.description: CI installs the latest omp release. The pin skips the 14-day age rule.
The minimum omp the README names. Renovate proposes no update for it: a person raises the pin by hand, in the same pull request as the README.
CI installs the latest OpenClaw release. The pin skips the 14-day age rule, and a rule here overrides the npm group above.
The CI-only OpenClaw install overrides the npm OpenClaw bundles when the pinned one carries advisories. That override also skips the 14-day age rule; no other npm does.

CI installs the latest Hermes Agent release, pinned by its tag and commit. The pin skips the 14-day age rule. Hermes also tags calendar builds such as v2026.9.24, which outrank the releases as versions, so they are not allowed.
The uv that setup-hermes installs moves with the action that installs it.

Only CI and the evals install the pins under .github/actions, and no plugin ships them, so their bumps are ci commits and release no version. This rule comes after the group rules, so it decides their type.

customManagers.description: The Hermes Agent tag the setup-hermes action installs and the commit it points at; the tags datasource resolves the commit of a new tag.
The uv version the setup-hermes action installs. It keeps the 14-day rule.
